identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.
anti_patterns: Sterile white backgrounds for food apps

headings.usage: Main headers, Section titles, Food Categories

primary.name: Zesty Tangerine
primary.usage: Primary Buttons, CTAs, Price Tags, Notification Badges

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay on hero sections to give a 'paper menu' feel.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Use subtle warm gradients (Orange -> Yellow) for 'Hot' items, but keep UI flat and clean.

dashboard.style: Soft Utility - Rounded corners, card-based but with 'Clay' feel
dashboard.density: Comfortable - Don't cram data. Food needs space to breathe.

buttons.interaction: Scale up slightly on hover (scale-105), shadow glow

cards.food_item: White card, rounded-2xl, image takes top 60%, content bottom 40%. Floating 'Add' button.
cards.seller_profile: Profile picture overlaps cover image. Clean typography.

hero_food.description: Pumpkin pancakes with honey - Warm, homemade vibe for Hero section

home_chef.description: Cheerful woman cooking - For 'Become a Seller' or 'Our Chefs' section

society_building.description: Modern apartment complex - For Society Registration/Selection page

food_hotpot.description: Hot pot meal - For 'Community Dining' or 'Family Meals' category

food_burger.description: Burger and fries - For 'Fast Food' or 'Snacks' category

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a 'Zomato for Societies'. The vibe must be TRUST + TASTE. It's not just food; it's your neighbor cooking.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Use the 'Fresh & Zesty' palette. Backgrounds should be #FDFBF7 (Warm Sand), not pure white. This mimics a table cloth or parchment.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import 'Nunito' for headings and 'DM Sans' for body from Google Fonts.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use 'Lucide-React' with rounded stroke endings if possible. Use 'Utensils', 'ChefHat', 'Building', 'Leaf' icons heavily.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use 'Framer Motion' for: 1. Staggered list entrance for food items. 2. 'Pop' effect when adding to cart. 3. Smooth page transitions.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: For Admin Dashboard, use Recharts with the custom palette (Tangerine, Basil, Yolk). Avoid default blues.
instructions_to_main_agent.forms: For Seller Onboarding (Aadhar/FSSAI), use multi-step forms with clear progress indicators. Make it feel official but not scary.

do_not: Do NOT use generic 'Inter' font for headings.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use #1A1A1A.
Do NOT make the UI crowded. Food photos need space.
Do NOT use 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use real food names (e.g., 'Aunty's Paneer Tikka', 'Sunday Special Biryani').
must_do: MUST use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements.
MUST ensure high contrast for accessibility.
MUST use the provided image URLs for placeholders.
